description: Docker fragment, covering both Dockerfiles and compose files. docker:pinDigests turns
`FROM golang:1.25-alpine` into `FROM golang:1.25-alpine@sha256:...`, which is what makes an
image build reproducible and what makes a base-image CVE visible as a diff rather than as a
silent re-pull. Base-image majors are held for approval because they move the distro, the libc
and usually the language runtime at once.

packageRules.description: Digest refreshes are how base-image security patches arrive — one PR, every week.
A base-image major changes the distro and the runtime underneath the app. Park it on the dashboard until someone chooses to do it.
Language runtime images must stay in step with the toolchain the repo actually builds with (go.mod go directive, .nvmrc, rust-toolchain). Renovate proposes; a human confirms they still match.
